stories.title: Local contractors to be invited to bid for £32m of work on Flintshire council homes
stories.summary: Four-year framework would start in April 2027, with open days planned for local firms.

stories.title: North Wales rail and bus programme wins two awards and a highly commended
stories.summary: The programme behind more trains on the North Wales Main Line and contactless ticketing at stations across the region has won two awards. Network North Wales, led by Transport for Wales (TfW), won the Delivering for the Customer and Acting as One Team: Infrastructure Delivery categories at the Rail Cymru Spotlight Rail Awards on Thursday

stories.title: North Wales Police chief to face MPs over plans to merge police forces
stories.summary: North Wales Police Chief Constable Amanda Blakeman will be questioned by MPs next week over UK Government plans that could see her force merged into a larger one. She will appear before the Welsh Affairs Committee at Westminster on Wednesday 18 November, alongside the chief constables of South Wales, Gwent and Dyfed-Powys police. The session

stories.title: No plans at the moment to sell County Hall site, Flintshire Council officer says
stories.summary: The officer said the council is working through demolition and will look at development before considering any sale.

stories.title: Power back on is part of Shotton and Aston hit by Friday evening outage
stories.summary: Update, 22:09 13 Nov: SP Energy Networks says power has been restored. Earlier report:Part of Shotton and Aston is without power this evening after an unplanned power cut, with SP Energy Networks aiming to restore supplies by 10.39pm. The fault was reported at 8.39pm and affects 55 postcodes: CH5 3AB, CH5 3EU, CH5 3EZ, CH5
